intro: Letter Snap: Term Challenge – A fast, vibrant word challenge to test your speed!
description:
Letter Snap: Term Challenge is a fun, engaging, and fast-paced word game designed for puzzle lovers of all ages. Challenge yourself with thousands of jumbled letter combinations to sharpen your vocabulary and quick thinking.

Play across various themed categories to test your knowledge at your own pace, or push your limits in Endless Mode—where you race against a ticking clock, build massive high-score streaks, and see how long you can keep your momentum alive!

Whether you want to expand your word bank, improve your problem-solving skills, or just enjoy a relaxing mental workout, it offers the perfect balance of brain training and satisfying arcade fun.

Get ready to snap cards into place, beat the clock, and unlock your ultimate word-solving potential!
